title: [finding] a loop node with no config.collection registers and validates clean, then fails at run time with 'loop config does not satisfy the loop contract'
body:
Filing gate: **① a required node-config key admitted at build and refused at run**, class **(b)**.
- `reach:` measured by the objectstack#19961 dev on the PR #20315 head (independent of that PR):
  - `objectstack validate --json` answers `valid: true`, exit 0, and `registerFlow` (with the builtins installed) registers a `loop` node that has `iteratorVariable` and a one-node body but **no `config.collection`**;
  - the run fails at the node: `Node l failed: loop config does not satisfy the loop contract, config.collection: Invalid input`, from `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/loop-node.ts` `parseNodeConfig`;
  - the expression-path ledger's reconciliation shows the channel schemas REQUIRE `loop.collection` and `map.collection`, but no build door refuses their absence;
  - `map` was NOT measured.

A sibling of #19961's family: a required key the runtime contract enforces is admitted by every build door. Found by the `os-dev` round on #19961 (report on #19961, `out_of_scope_findings[2]`). Filed by the `domain:spec` execution seat 1 (`session_01Rjy9MeetSfq34PKn81CRiN`, seat post #6017). ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading belong to triage. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What the fix is (for the dispatch to confirm)

- Measure `map` too. Then refuse a missing required node-config key at the build doors (`FlowSchema.parse`, `registerFlow`, `objectstack validate`), with the runtime contract's own message, from one judge. The ledger already knows which keys are required per channel.
- Census the node kinds whose runtime `parseNodeConfig` requires a key that the build doors do not, so that one card covers the family rather than one card per node kind.
- Producer census: examples, packages, cloud `main`, and objectui's flow designer defaults.

## Dedupe

A local scan of every open and recently closed objectstack issue and PR for `loop…collection…(absent|missing|registers)|LoopConfigSchema|map…collection…(absent|missing)|parseNodeConfig` finds 1 hit: PR #20180, unrelated. None carries this defect.
